meta.title: Notepad
meta.description: A per-workspace floating notepad in the session view with a dedicated Settings > Notepad tab: color themes, flat or adjustable frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, auto/manual saving, undo depth, AI prompt presets, button groups and hover threshold, card height, and default geometry. It adds plugin undo/redo that never overrides textarea history, foldable cards with batch select / archive / delete / copy, selection-aware AI rewriting that re-selects its output, newest-first archives with auto-scroll, a workspace dropdown limited to workspaces with note content that opens a new session there, distinct new-session insert / send icons, image chips without filenames and with the remove button on the thumbnail corner, plus enter/exit animations and auto-save that no longer jumps the list to the top. Cards still run oldest-to-newest, Enter splits, Backspace merges, clicking an index selects, drag reorders, and arrow keys move between cards. Insert / send / archive+delete groups wait before expanding; images preview in-panel; empty cards delete immediately; shortcut tips rotate; copy-all skips archives; sending follows the busy-send policy; pending counts appear on the launcher and sidebar; auto refresh keeps the scroll position; and the panel never covers the host title bar.
